==Hero Usage==
Heroes will not use this skill on their own unless an enemy in combat activates a touch skill. They will not proactively use it to prevent touch skills, nor as a basic shout to trigger Echoes.

==Notes==
* This is the only skill that prevents touch skills; however, it does not work against [[Touch of Dhuum]] nor [[Smash of the Titans]].
* This skill will not prevent friendly touch skills and does not count them toward ending the shout's effect.
{{anomaly|Unlike most shouts, "Can't Touch This!" ends if it's reapplied before it expires, triggering the effects of [[echo (skill type)|echo]]es.}}
{{bug|"Can't Touch This!" is applied to [[party]] members only.}} <!--[[Category:Affects Allies]]-->

==Trivia==
*The name of this skill is a reference to the [[wikipedia:MC Hammer|MC Hammer]] song [[wikipedia:U Can't Touch This|"U Can't Touch This"]].
*The [[skill icon]] portrays two [[necromancer]]s wearing [[Necromancer Vabbian armor|Vabbian armor]].
